//: Declaration blocks of four or more declarations that two or more rules state identically. Each entry is debt this phase deliberately did not pay, with the reason it was left. An entry goes stale -- and the test fails -- as soon as either the declarations or the set of rules stating them changes, so a fold cannot quietly become a rewrite. Adding an entry is a claim that the duplication is not a second implementation of a primitive; say which primitive would own it instead.

groups.why: Definition-list value. Part of the same unclaimed metadata-list primitive as the other `dd` rules below.
Muted body copy with `overflow-wrap`. Same unclaimed `.note` typography primitive as group 3, with a wrapping rule rather than a bottom gap.
Padded muted prose inside an unavailable-state card. The empty/unavailable-state card is its own unclaimed primitive.
Uppercase label above a control. Same unclaimed form-control family as group 8.
Four-up metric grid. Activity and the dashboards page count different things into the same grid; a `.metric-grid` primitive is unclaimed work.
Secondary line under a table cell. Table *cells* were consolidated in Phase 3; per-column secondary text is still feature-owned, and `.table-secondary` already exists for the sites that opted in.
Bare `button` descendant rule carrying two colour literals (`#557149`, `17px`) that scripts/css-literal-debt.json still records. Consolidating it means retiring those literals first.
Definition-list value, as group 9.
Toolbar text input. The input/select control family is the largest remaining un-consolidated primitive and is explicitly out of Phase 3's slice (buttons, status, badges, tables, chrome, overlays).
Bordered search field. Same unclaimed form-control family as group 8, at the composed-field rather than the bare-input level.

Bare `button` descendant rule -- a link-styled text button. Phase 3 consolidated `.button` call sites; the 238 remaining bare `button` descendant rules are documented in docs/theming.md as feature-owner work.
Bare `button` descendant rule inside the knowledge manager, as group 13.

Knowledge-manager eyebrow, stated twice inside one file. The two rules read the same since Phase 5 put the related-inspector eyebrow's 8px on --type-xxs; before that they differed by one pixel of type and by nothing else, which is what kept the duplication out of this file. Same unclaimed eyebrow primitive as the `.knowledge-manager__eyebrow` rule beside them.

sites: app/admin/admin.css :: .lookup-manager__toolbar label > span, .lookup-manager__editor label > span, .lookup-manager__upload label > span
groups.why: Uppercase field label, three copies inside the knowledge and lookup managers. Same unclaimed form-control family as group 8.

Text input and select inside the knowledge and lookup managers -- four copies of the same control. The single largest entry in this file and the clearest candidate for the next consolidation phase. The fourth site's selector was respelled in Phase 5 from two chained `:not()` calls to one selector list, which matches the same elements and is the notation `selector-not-notation` asks for.
Two-column metadata grid, as group 9.
Fieldset legend carrying the `#43545d` literal that scripts/css-literal-debt.json still records; consolidating it means retiring that literal first.
Two-column grid, as group 24, at a different gap owner.
Inline code inside a knowledge-manager relationship row, as group 15.
Status strip along the bottom of a knowledge-manager panel. Ten declarations, two copies: the largest single restatement left, and a strong candidate for a `.panel-status` primitive.
Muted small print, as group 3.
Muted body copy, four copies. Same unclaimed `.note` typography primitive as group 3.
Bare `button` descendant rule -- a bordered toolbar button. Same remaining debt as group 13.

Tinted square icon tile. `.dataset-icon` and `.summary-icon` have been the same tile since Phase 2 gave both the accent wash; Phase 5 put the summary tile's 17px on --type-xl and the last difference between them went. Both want the unclaimed icon-tile primitive `.metric-symbol` and `.app-launch-icon` also copy.
Uppercase section label. Same unclaimed label vocabulary as group 19, at the section rather than the field level.
Feature layout, not a primitive: an analytics context bar and the search title happen to be the same flex row. Consolidating needs a named inline-row primitive, which no phase has defined.

sites: app/analytics/analytics.css :: .analytics-insight-list footer a, .analytics-field-list a, .analytics-slowest-list a, .analytics-slowest-footer a
groups.why: Inline text link. A `.link` primitive is Phase 4 typography work; these three are feature-owned link styles that arrived at the same weight independently.

Muted body copy inside a card. Candidate for a `.note` typography primitive; the trailing `margin: 0 0 9px` differs from the other muted-copy rules only by its bottom gap, so folding needs a spacing decision this phase did not make.

Single-line truncation. The three sites truncate different content (a link, a query, an event title); the shared shape is the truncation idiom, which belongs in a utility class rather than in a component primitive.

Chart stroke geometry. Charts are their own primitive family and no phase has consolidated them; the analytics trend line and the workspace time-series line are drawn by two different components. Phase 4 named the one thing a host is allowed to change -- `--chart-stroke-width` -- so both rules read it, but the six declarations are still written twice.

sites: app/dashboards/operations-dashboard.css :: .operations-create-form label > span, .operations-settings-grid label > span, .operations-panel-fields label > span
groups.why: Two rules inside one stylesheet, both field labels for the operations dashboard. Folding is a one-file edit the dashboard owner should make with the rest of app/dashboards/operations-dashboard.css.
Inline code truncation, the same idiom as group 4 applied to `<code>`.
Absolutely positioned grid lines behind a chart. Chart primitive family, as group 5.
